deploymentEvidence.description: Modern official contract list binds original WISE token and staking to this Ethereum address; current staking docs separately endorse regular staking.

lifecycleEvidence.description: Current primary ecosystem/staking documentation and live app support original regular WISE stakes; maintained modern docs contain July2026 screenshots. No broad claim that all historic Wise Finance surfaces remain maintained.

selectedFunctions.label: Wise Token createStake financial position operation
warnings: Static source/ABI metadata only; not an API-key grant, live availability or authorization, persistent runtime attestation, principal/backing/yield safety, funded execution or a complete workflow. Independent policies, grants, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum original WiseToken regular staking only, counted once across Wise Token/Wise Finance; not StakeWise. Sourcify reports runtimeMatch=match and creationMatch=match, not exact_match, and no proxy. Modern official docs explicitly maintain regular staking and link this exact token/staking address. Advanced NFT staking, RWA strategies and Wise lending are not admitted.

createStake burns msg.sender WISE and records a caller-owned stake; endStake and scrapeInterest read only msg.sender stake IDs and mint back to that caller. WISE amounts have 18 decimals, minimum stake is 1,000,000 base units and lockDays range 1..15,330. Stake starts next protocol day. Referrer must differ from caller and have no deployed code; zero referrer is allowed. No wallet/operator/delegation permission is granted.

Early ending an already started, unmatured stake loses principal according to source floor(stakedAmount * (100 + floor(800 * (daysLeft-1) / max(lockDays-1,1))) / 1000), not the simplified remaining-time percentage in current docs. Before start or after maturity penalty is zero. Remaining principal plus accrued WISE rewards is minted to caller; principal is not collateral-backed protection.

Scraping interest before maturity reduces remaining staking and referrer shares and may reduce future earnings; zero scrapeDays means all calculated days. Positive scrapeDays are caller-selected and may revert if snapshots are unavailable. Reward/day/share arithmetic rounds down; day loops and snapshot catch-up can consume substantial gas. No bounded-gas success or advertised APY is assured.

createStakeWithETH spends msg.value using fixed Uniswap V2 WETH->WISE path and then stakes output credited to msg.sender. createStakeWithToken pulls caller token, approves the fixed router internally, swaps token->WETH->WISE and stakes output; this is a fixed financial conversion, not arbitrary calldata execution. Both hard-code minimum swap output=1 and deadline=block.timestamp+2 hours, with no caller slippage minimum or custom deadline. Adverse execution/MEV risk is material. Only createStakeWithETH is payable; all other admitted methods require zero native value.

Referrer claims mint only caller-owned referral-link rewards. Existing critical-mass eligibility, underlying stake state and snapshot accounting apply; processDays bounds processing only for ended/mature stakes, while active stakes use elapsed days. Bulk stake and referral methods are fixed loops, not multicall; matched array lengths, balances, and practical gas bounds are caller responsibility and one revert reverts the whole call.

Accrual depends on configured Uniswap pair reserves, hard-coded liquidity guard 0x9c306cad86550ec80d77668c0a8bee6eb34684b6 and fixed router/factory/token behavior. Liquidity-guard rates can reallocate inflation. These dependency deployments and current balances are not independently attested. No pause/read state or fee-free execution guarantee is asserted.

Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://wisesoft.gitbook.io/wise/wise-token/staking-wise.md). # Staking WISE WISE total supply has 4% fixed annual inflation (offset by burns). 3% rewards stakers, and 1% rewards referrers. Unstaking WISE early is penalized, so staked WISE creates a true supply shock. ## How to Create WISE stakes: \ To start a WISE stake, go to our [staking tab](https://app.wisetoken.com/staking) and click the blue "New Stake" button. Advanced stakes are recommended since they are bonded to an NFT that that can be sold, transferred, or borrowed against later on, but the max length for an advanced stake is 10 years, so if you wish to stake for 11-42 years, then create a regular stake. {% hint style="info" %} Remember: Penalties are **high** for unstaking early, so make sure to choose an amount and duration that you don't mind leaving until maturity. Only the bravest of the brave choose 42 years! {% endhint %} ## The Share Price System: The WISE staking contract uses a unique share price system to determine how much of the available WISE inflation you earn relative to other stakers. You can do two things to advantage your stake: stake ***early*** and stake ***longer*****.** Share price only goes up over time, meaning even those who stake *after* you, even if they stake the same amount and duration will earn *less*. Your stakes will earn higher APY the longer they go untouched, because you will gain relative share power every time other stakes end during your staking period. Long stakes end up earning much more on this fact alone. Earning is also a factor of how much of the total supply is staked vs in wallets and in our Uniswap pool. Less WISE staked and a large percentage on Uniswap means WISE price is down, but stakers are earning high APY. More WISE staked and less WISE on Uniswap means lower APY, but happy stakers, because WISE price is going up. ## Scraping interest on WISE stakes: Scraping a WISE stake allows you to withdraw your earnings instantly without affecting your principal**, but it carries a penalty that imacts your remaining APY!** When you scrape, it resets the critical compounding advantage gained from staking early, treating your scraped stake as if it just started that day. **Scrape only in emergencies**, because this reset diminishes your future returns for the remainder of the lockup period. To scrape, click the magnifying glass on the right hand side of your stake. ## Ending a WISE Stake Before Maturity: You may end your stake any time before maturity, but you will pay a **significant penalty**. The penalty is equivalent to the percentage of remaining time on your stake. For example: a 100 day stake ended on day 30 will cost **70% of your principal** to end...yikes! The penalized WISE gets distributed globally and proportionally among the remaining WISE stakers. If ending your stake early is *absolutely necessary*, you can end by clicking the red X on the right hand side of your stake..

> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://wisesoft.gitbook.io/wise/llms.txt). Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://wisesoft.gitbook.io/wise/wise-token/wise-referrals.md). # WISE referrals The WISE referral system is funded using 25% of WISE inflation (75% goes to stakers). In order to start earning referrals you must first become a "Critical Mass Referrer". ## Critical Mass Referrer: You must refer $10,000 USD of WISE stakes in order to become a CMR and start earning WISE from referrals. The USD amount is calculated on the day each stake is created. Any stakes started while building up $10k of WISE stakes do not retroactively start earning referral rewards after you achieve CMR status, so it is best to have your first referree stake at least $10k in USD value. ## Creating a Referral link: Visit our referral tab in the Staking section, after connecting your crypto wallet. Anyone clicking your link will have a cookie stored in their browser that credits any stakes they create under your referral link. You only earn rewards from direct referrals (WISE is not a MLM model). ## Scraping Referral Interest: After reaching CMR status, you will see your referred stakes start showing up in your referral tab. You can scrape the referral interest earned off these stakes whenever you want without penalty. When your referee's stake matures, or if they early end stake, you will stop earning referral interest on that stake. Click the "+" sign on the right side of each referred stake to select the ones you wish to scrape, then tap the "collect" button when ready. You can "select all" to gather every stake on that page, and it's recommended that you mass collect no more than 50 stakes at a time for the smoothest results.
